decisions.reason: As a flagship biodynamic yogurt extension in the firm's core organic dairy range, it matches established capabilities and brand identity, and with no negative signal visible after another year the option value still favors keeping it.
This mild sliced cheese is a close-to-core line extension, so the cost of keeping it on the market is relatively low and one year is still early to abandon it without clearer evidence of weak demand.

The sliced butter cheese also sits squarely in the firm's traditional organic cheese business, and because uncertainty about repeat demand can still resolve at limited carrying cost, management would keep the option open.
